text:
Nachdem ich heute dato die Vorwerks Wirtschafts
Gebäude zu Swięcia nebst darzu gehörigen Aekkern
Wiesen Waldungen pp an den Johann Christian Birlack
aus Zilenzig, Johan Götzinger aus Brennenhofs Fleis
Joh. Siebert aus Zamaika bey Sonnenburg und an
Friedrich Götzinger Gastwirth zu Posen Erbpachtsweise
überlaßen, hiervon aber das eigentliche herrschaftliche Wohn¬
haus zu Swięcia ausgezogen habe. So überlaße und
schenke ich hiermit dieses herrschaftliche Wohnhaus zu
Swięcia an den Friedrich Götzinger Gastwirth zu Posen
als eine Erkenntlichkeit für die bey diesem Erbpachts Ge¬
schäfte gehabte Mühwaltung und Reisen erb und eigenthüm¬
lich um da mit nach seinen Gefallen schalten und walten
und gebahren zu können, und weil derselbe dieses Haus bey
der übernommenen Brauerey Erbpacht zum Schank besonder¬
gut brauchen kann.
Breslau den 8ten Aprill 1803.
Friedrich Ludwig Fürst zu Hohenlohe

translation.en:
Whereas I have this day made over by way of hereditary lease the demesne-farm and husbandry buildings at Swięcia, together with the arable, meadows, woodlands etc. belonging thereto, to Johann Christian Birlack of Zilenzig, Johan Götzinger of Brennenhofs Fleis, Joh. Siebert of Zamaika near Sonnenburg, and to Friedrich Götzinger, innkeeper at Posen, but have thereby excepted from it the proper manorial dwelling-house at Swięcia: I therefore herewith make over and give this manorial dwelling-house at Swięcia to Friedrich Götzinger, innkeeper at Posen, as a mark of acknowledgement for the trouble taken and the journeys made by him in this hereditary-lease business, to him and his heirs as his own property, so that he may deal, dispose and do therewith at his pleasure, and because he can make particularly good use of this house for the tap in connexion with the brewery hereditary lease he has taken over.

Breslau, the 8th of April 1803.

Friedrich Ludwig Fürst zu Hohenlohe

text_english:

Siebert of Zamaika near Sonnenburg, and to Friedrich Götzinger, innkeeper at Posen, but have thereby excepted from it the proper manorial dwelling-house at Swięcia: I therefore herewith make over and give this manorial dwelling-house at Swięcia to Friedrich Götzinger, innkeeper at Posen, as a mark of acknowledgement for the trouble taken and the journeys made by him in this hereditary-lease business, to him and his heirs as his own property, so that he may deal, dispose and do therewith at his pleasure, and because he can make particularly good use of this house for the tap in connexion with the brewery hereditary lease he has taken over.

Breslau, the 8th of April 1803.

Friedrich Ludwig Fürst zu Hohenlohe
summary_en: Deed of gift by which Friedrich Ludwig Fürst zu Hohenlohe conveys the manorial dwelling-house at Swięcia — expressly excepted from the hereditary lease of the demesne-farm, husbandry buildings, arable, meadows and woodlands granted the same day to Johann Christian Birlack of Zilenzig, Johan Götzinger of Brennenhofs Fleis, Joh. Siebert of Zamaika near Sonnenburg and Friedrich Götzinger — to Götzinger, innkeeper at Posen, and his heirs as his own property, in acknowledgement of his trouble and journeys in the hereditary-lease business and for use as a tap with his brewery lease.
summary_de: Schenkungsurkunde: Nachdem Friedrich Ludwig Fürst zu Hohenlohe das Vorwerk Swięcia samt Wirtschaftsgebäuden, Äckern, Wiesen und Waldungen an Johann Christian Birlack aus Zilenzig, Johan Götzinger aus Brennenhofs Fleis, Joh. Siebert aus Zamaika bei Sonnenburg und Friedrich Götzinger, Gastwirt zu Posen, in Erbpacht ausgetan, das herrschaftliche Wohnhaus in Swięcia jedoch davon ausgenommen hat, überträgt er dieses Haus dem Gastwirt Friedrich Götzinger und dessen Erben als Eigentum – zur Anerkennung seiner Mühen und Reisen in der Erbpachtsache und zum Ausschank bei der übernommenen Brauerei-Erbpacht.
